title: Leadline Evidence Route Contract
description: The ordered, auditable plan Leadline emits per turn. Legible to humans, structured for enforcement.

need.description: The epistemic evidence family this obligation requires.

provider.description: Adapter-resolved tool for this need (e.g. gbrain, graphify, grep, cli-probe).

source.description: What produced this classification, e.g. 'tell:did-we' or 'embedding'.

availability.description: Hard feasibility state from the arbiter; distinct from classification confidence.

fallback.description: Explicit degraded path with reason when the preferred provider is unavailable. Never rewrites 'need'.

ordered_route.description: The needs in execution order. Usually one step; sometimes two or three.
